From bf7bc8c5974b78a09f266be3a5a84ed3865f30a6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Feb 2024 09:40:51 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mac80211: don't add VHT capa on links without them

When a link doesn't have VHT capability, before the rework
we'd have set IEEE80211_CONN_DISABLE_VHT, but now with the
linear progression of 'mode', we no longer have that. Add
an explicit check for VHT being supported, so we don't add
a zeroed VHT capabilities element where it shouldn't be.

Fixes: 310c8387c638 ("wifi: mac80211: clean up connection process")
Reviewed-by: Miriam Rachel Korenblit <miriam.rachel.korenblit@intel.com>
Link: https://msgid.link/20240228094207.bfe4283bcde7.Ib70a558bc6bdbcec3d9e663079229dfcc2493682@changeid
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/net/mac80211/mlme.c b/net/mac80211/mlme.c
index c60d23da91fe..a2dca15d9c2e 100644
--- a/net/mac80211/mlme.c
+++ b/net/mac80211/mlme.c
@@ -1319,7 +1319,8 @@ static size_t ieee80211_assoc_link_elems(struct ieee80211_sub_if_data *sdata,
 						offset);
 
 	if (sband->band != NL80211_BAND_6GHZ &&
-	    assoc_data->link[link_id].conn.mode >= IEEE80211_CONN_MODE_VHT) {
+	    assoc_data->link[link_id].conn.mode >= IEEE80211_CONN_MODE_VHT &&
+	    sband->vht_cap.vht_supported) {
 		bool mu_mimo_owner =
 			ieee80211_add_vht_ie(sdata, skb, sband,
 					     &assoc_data->link[link_id].ap_vht_cap,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/mac80211/mlme.c`**
   - A conditional check was added to ensure that VHT (Very High Throughput) capabilities are only included if they are supported. Specifically, the line:
     ```c
     assoc_data->link[link_id].conn.mode >= IEEE80211_CONN_MODE_VHT &&
     sband->vht_cap.vht_supported
     ```
     was introduced to prevent the addition of a zeroed VHT capabilities element when the link does not support VHT.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `mlme.c` directly addresses a bug related to the handling of VHT capabilities in the connection process. Previously, the code would allow for the addition of VHT capabilities even when they were not supported, which could lead to incorrect behavior. The new check ensures that VHT capabilities are only added when they are actually supported by the link, thus fixing the issue introduced by a previous patch (identified by the Fixes tag). This change enhances the robustness of the connection process in the mac80211 subsystem of the Wi-Fi stack.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (sband->band != NL80211_BAND_6GHZ &&
    assoc_data->link[link_id].conn.mode >= IEEE80211_CONN_MODE_VHT) {
```
Reason:
This code checks if the connection mode is at least VHT (Very High Throughput) but does not verify if VHT capabilities are actually supported by the current band. As a result, it may attempt to add VHT capabilities even when they are not supported, leading to the addition of a zeroed VHT capabilities element.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (sband->band != NL80211_BAND_6GHZ &&
    assoc_data->link[link_id].conn.mode >= IEEE80211_CONN_MODE_VHT &&
    sband->vht_cap.vht_supported) {
```
Reason:
This modification adds an explicit check for `sband->vht_cap.vht_supported`, ensuring that VHT capabilities are only added if they are actually supported by the band. This prevents the incorrect addition of a zeroed VHT capabilities element when the link does not support VHT, thus fixing the bug.
